chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurara from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

If a man sends news to his family or they are informed that he has divorced her, and she completes her waiting period, then she marries another man, and her first husband comes back, then the first is more entitled to her than this latter one; whether he had consummated the marriage or not. And the latter cannot marry her again, and she is entitled to the dowry for what he made lawful of her private part.

key_terms.دَخَلَ بِهَا: He consummated the marriage with her

ai.seo_question: What are the rights of the first husband if his ex-wife marries another man after completing her waiting period?
ai.summary: This hadith from al- Istibsar clarifies the ruling of 'Iddah al-Mutallaqah (waiting period for a revocable divorce) where the first husband retains the right of Rujūʿ (reconciliation) even after the wife has married a second man. It establishes that the second husband's marriage is valid but becomes 'Muḥarramah' (permanently prohibited) to her if the first husband exercises his right before or after consummation, with the second husband retaining his dowry as compensation for his marital rights.
